# Pricing strategy (Corey Haines)

Helps set SaaS pricing, packaging, tiers and price increases.

- Source: https://github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills/main/skills/pricing/SKILL.md
- Author: Corey Haines
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/pricing-strategy-corey-haines-0abd00dc

Claude first gathers business context, competition, current performance and goals, then works through value metrics, good-better-best tiers, per-seat versus usage pricing, freemium and trials, and research methods such as Van Westendorp and MaxDiff. It also covers when and how to raise prices and pricing page design. Reference files and evals ship with the skill.

**Try asking:**
- "What should we charge for our analytics tool? Here's our context"
- "Design three pricing tiers for a B2B scheduling app"
- "Is it time to raise prices, and how do we handle existing customers?"
